blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning capabilities in large language models have evolved from prompting-based methods to internalized model behaviors. In this paper, we investigate whether the internal thinking model of an LLM can be deliberately changed and whether such a change is beneficial. Instead of relying on Chain-of-Thought, we train models to follow Question--Option--Criteria (QOC), a structured decision process that decomposes a task into explicit questions, competing options, and evaluation criteria. We present a three-generation development pipeline that ranges from a basic QOC decision core to richer answer synthesis and statistically enriched QOC reasoning. We then evaluate the resulting models with respect to both internal consistency and output quality. Across the reported experiments, QOC-based fine-tuning improves answer quality relative to non-fine-tuned base models and yields particularly strong gains once models are large enough to execute the underlying QOC computations reliably. The results suggest that the internal thinking model of an LLM is trainable and that structured alternatives to Chain-of-Thought can provide a promising path toward more reliable, interpretable, and task-adapted decision support.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型中的理性能力已经从基于激励的方法演变为内化模型行为. 在本文中,我们调查是否可以故意改变LLM的内部思维模式,以及这种改变是否有益。 我们不依靠 " 思考链 " ,而是培训遵循 " 问题-备选-标准 " (QOC)的模型,这是一个结构化的决策进程,将一项任务分解为明确的问题、相互竞争的选择和评价标准。 我们提出了一个三代发展管道,它从基本质量OC决定核心到更丰富的回答综合和统计上丰富的质量OC推理。 然后,我们在内部一致性和产出质量方面评价由此产生的模式。 在整个报告的实验中,基于QOC的微调比非精细调试的基础模型提高了解答质量,一旦模型足够大,足以可靠地执行基本的QOC计算,则会产生特别强的收益。 结果表明,LLM的内部思维模式是可训练的,结构化的 " 思考链 " 的替代品可以为更可靠、可解释和适合任务的决定支持提供有希望的途径。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: This paper investigates a practical next step in the evolution of reasoning-oriented large language models (LLMs): not only eliciting reasoning, but deliberately changing the internal thinking model that a model is trained to follow. Early progress in reasoning quality was largely driven by prompting techniques, most notably Chain-of-Thought (CoT), that encouraged non-thinking base models to externalize intermediate reasoning steps [ 9 , 5 ] . Over time, these externally elicited traces became training signals, enabling models to internalize structured reasoning behavior through rationale-based training and distillation pipelines [ 11 , 4 ] . Our work follows this same development logic, but replaces CoT with a different and more explicitly decision-oriented framework: Question–Option–Criteria (QOC) [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 本文调查了面向推理的大型语言模型(LLMS)进化的下一步实用性:不仅引申推理,还刻意改变一个模型训练要遵循的内部思维模型. 推理质量的早期进展主要是由激励技术驱动的,最显著的是思维链(CoT),鼓励非思维基础模型将中间推理步骤[9,5]外部化. 随着时间的推移,这些外部引出的痕迹成为培训信号,使模型能够通过基于原理的培训和蒸馏管道将结构化的推理行为内部化[11,4]. 我们的工作遵循同样的发展逻辑,但用一个不同、更明确的决策导向框架取代了CoT: Question-Object-Criteria (QOC) [6].

blocks.en: The core hypothesis is that QOC offers a better scaffold for decision support tasks because it enforces separation between (i) the decision question, (ii) competing options, and (iii) explicit evaluation criteria. This structure is particularly useful when explainability matters: rather than producing only a final recommendation, the model can expose why certain options dominate and where trade-offs occur, aligning with broader explainability goals in AI decision support [ 7 , 3 ] . We therefore aim to improve both decision quality and interpretability by training models to reason in QOC form and then communicate outcomes in user-appropriate detail.
blocks.zh: 核心假说是QOC为决策支持任务提供了更好的脚手架,因为它执行的是(一)决定问题,(二)竞争选择,(三)明确的评价标准之间的分离. 在可解释性问题时,这一结构特别有用:该模式不只提出最后建议,反而可以揭示为什么某些选择占主导地位,以及在哪些地方进行权衡,与大赦国际决定支持的更广泛的可解释性目标相一致[7, 3]。 因此,我们的目标是提高决策质量和可解释性,培训模式要以 " QOC " 形式说明理由,然后以适当的用户详细方式通报结果。

blocks.en: To operationalize this idea, we developed and trained three model generations, each extending the previous one.
blocks.zh: 为了落实这一想法,我们开发并培训了三代模范,每一代都延续了前一代。

blocks.en: In the first generation, the model was trained to produce a QOC thinking structure and to return only the best-performing option to the user. The response layer was intentionally minimal: no extended justification, no narrative explanation, and no additional contextualization beyond the top-ranked option. This generation served as a baseline for testing whether QOC alone can improve internal decision consistency and option ranking quality.
blocks.zh: 在第一代中,该模型接受了制作QOC思维结构的培训,并且只将表现最好的选项还给用户. 反应层是故意最小化的:没有延伸的理由,没有叙述性解释,除了排名最高的选项之外,没有额外的背景化. 这一代作为测试单凭QOC能否提高内部决策一致性和选项排序质量的基线.

blocks.en: In the second generation, we reused the same QOC thinking structure but changed the response mechanism. Instead of returning only the winning option, we fed the generated QOC structure back into an LLM—specifically, the same model family that produced the structure—and prompted it to interpret the result and provide a more detailed answer. This introduced a two-stage behavior: structured decision formation followed by explanatory rendering. For training, both artifacts were retained: the intermediate QOC reasoning representation and the richer textual response used to communicate the decision.
blocks.zh: 在第二代中,我们重用相同的QOC思维结构,但改变了反应机制. 我们不只返回获胜的选择,而是将生成的QOC结构反馈到一个LLM——具体来说就是产生结构的同一个模型家族——并促使它解释结果,提供更详细的答案. 这引入了一个两阶段行为:结构化决策形成,然后是解释性解释. 在培训方面,保留了两种文物:中间的QOC推理表述和用来传达决定的更丰富的文字反应.

blocks.en: In the third generation, we further expanded the reasoning structure by incorporating lightweight statistical analysis into the QOC stage. Beyond identifying the best option, the model also computed comparative indicators for near-best options, including dispersion-oriented measures such as standard deviation to reflect stability and sensitivity across criteria. As in generation two, the complete enriched thinking structure was then passed back to the LLM for interpretation into a rich, user-facing answer. Again, both components—the structured reasoning trace and the interpreted response—were included in fine-tuning data for the corresponding model version.
blocks.zh: 在第三代中,我们进一步扩大推理结构,将轻量级统计分析纳入QOC阶段. 除了确定最佳选择外,该模型还计算了近乎最佳选择的比较指标,包括以分散为导向的衡量标准,如反映不同标准的稳定性和敏感性的标准偏差。 和第二代一样,完全丰富的思维结构后来被传回LLM,用于解释成一个丰富,用户化的答案. 同样,在相应的模型版本的微调数据中纳入了两个部分——结构化推理跟踪和解释性反应。

blocks.en: Across these three generations, the development trajectory moves from pure structured selection to structured-and-explained decision support, and finally to statistically informed structured-and-explained decision support. This progression enables a direct evaluation of how much additional explanatory and analytical layers contribute to internal consistency, output quality, and practical interpretability for end users. At the same time, it makes it possible to study a broader question that emerged as central over the course of this paper: whether deeper internal thinking structures are equally useful across model sizes, or whether smaller and larger models benefit from different depths of structured reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在这三代人中,发展轨迹从纯粹的结构化选择转向结构化和解释化的决策支持,最后转向统计上知情的结构化和解释化的决策支持. 这一进展使得能够直接评价在多大程度上额外的解释和分析层有助于内部一致性、产出质量和最终用户的实际解释性。 同时,它也使得研究一个在本文过程中作为中心出现的更广泛的问题成为可能:更深入的内部思维结构在模型大小上是否同样有用,或者较小和更大的模型是否从结构推理的不同深度中获益.

blocks.en: 2 State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 2 艺术状况

blocks.en: Recent progress in LLM reasoning started with prompting methods that elicit intermediate steps. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting established the core paradigm for improving multi-step reasoning quality in sufficiently large models [ 9 ] . Closely related work showed that even simple zero-shot trigger phrases can induce strong reasoning gains without handcrafted exemplars [ 5 ] . Beyond greedy decoding, self-consistency improved CoT by sampling diverse reasoning paths and selecting stable answers [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近,在LLM推理方面取得了进展,首先采用了引发中间步骤的方法。 启发思考链(COT)建立了在足够大的模型中提高多步骤推理质量的核心范式[9]. 密切相关的研究表明,即使简单的零射触发短语也可以在没有手动示例的情况下诱导强大的推理增益[5]. 除了贪婪的解码外,自我一致性通过取样各种推理路径和选择稳定的答案来改进CoT[8].

blocks.en: The transition from prompting to model-internal reasoning behavior has also been supported by iterative rationale-based training methods such as STaR, which bootstraps reasoning ability via self-generated and filtered rationales [ 11 ] . In parallel, ReAct demonstrated that combining explicit reasoning traces with environment actions can improve both task performance and interpretability [ 10 ] . Distillation-based approaches further showed that stepwise reasoning traces can be transferred into smaller models while retaining strong reasoning performance [ 4 ] . Taken together, these lines of work suggest that reasoning quality does not only depend on scale or prompting, but also on the form of the internal reasoning structure that a model is encouraged or trained to follow.
blocks.zh: 从催化到模型-内部推理行为的过渡也得到了基于迭代原理的训练方法的支持,如STaR,它通过自我生成和过滤推理[11],将推理能力拖动. 与此同时,ReAct表明,将明确的推理痕迹与环境行动相结合,既可以提高任务性能,也可以提高可解释性[10]。 基于沉淀的方法进一步表明,逐步推理痕迹可以转移到较小的模型中,同时保留强推理性能[4]. 总而言之,这些工作线索表明,推理的质量不仅取决于规模或激励,而且还取决于鼓励或培训一个模型遵循的内部推理结构的形式。

blocks.en: For the QOC perspective adopted in this paper, the conceptual foundation is design-space analysis with explicit Questions, Options, and Criteria [ 6 ] . In contrast to CoT-style reasoning, which typically unfolds as a free-form sequential rationale, QOC imposes an explicitly decision-oriented structure by separating the decision question, the available alternatives, and the evaluative criteria used to compare them. This makes QOC especially relevant for settings in which explainability, trade-off transparency, and auditable decision support are important. The present work builds on this perspective by treating QOC not merely as an output format, but as an internal thinking model that can be trained into an LLM and evaluated with respect to both internal consistency and output quality.
blocks.zh: 就本文件所采用的 " 质量控制 " 观点而言,概念基础是设计-空间分析,其中明确了问题、选择和标准[6]。 与通常作为自由形式顺序理由展开的CoT式推理不同,QOC通过将决定问题,现有替代办法,以及用于比较这些办法的评价标准分开,规定了一个明确面向决定的结构. 这使得质量控制特别适用于解释性、权衡透明度和可审计决策支持十分重要的场合。 目前的工作以这一视角为基础,不仅将质量控制标准视为一种产出格式,而且也视为一种内部思维模式,可将其培训成一个LLM,并对内部一致性和产出质量进行评价。

blocks.en: 3 The QOC (Question-Option-Criteria) Thinking Model
blocks.zh: 3 质量控制(问题-备选-标准) 思维模式

blocks.en: In this paper, Question–Option–Criteria (QOC) is used as a structured decision-making process that replaces unconstrained free-form reasoning with an explicit sequence of analytical steps. Instead of asking the model to directly generate an answer, we require it to first represent the problem in terms of a decision question, a set of alternative options, and a set of criteria according to which these options should be evaluated. This makes the reasoning process more transparent and more suitable for supervision, because the intermediate decision structure can be inspected, validated, and reused during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,Question-Object-Criteria(QOC)被用作结构化的决策过程,用明确的分析步骤序列取代不受约束的自由形式推理. 与其要求模型直接生成一个答案,我们要求模型首先从决定问题、一套备选选择和一套标准的角度来代表问题,根据这些标准对这些选择进行评价。 这使得推理过程更加透明,更适合监督,因为中间决定结构可以在微调时被检查,验证,再利用.

blocks.en: The QOC process begins with an input task consisting of a question and a supporting context. From this input, the model first formulates the concrete decision question that has to be answered. It then identifies the relevant answer options, that is, the competing alternatives between which the decision will be made. In a next step, the model extracts or formulates the criteria that are relevant for judging these options. These criteria provide the evaluative dimensions of the decision and define what counts as a strong or weak option in the given context.
blocks.zh: QOC进程从一个包含一个问题和一个辅助背景的输入任务开始. 从这一投入中,模型首先提出了需要回答的具体决策问题。 然后确定相关的答案选项,即作出决定时相互竞争的选项。 在下一个步骤中,模型提取或制定与判断这些选项相关的标准. 这些标准提供了决定的评价层面,并界定了在特定情况下什么是强弱的选择。

blocks.en: Once the criteria have been identified, the QOC process assigns an importance weight to each criterion. These weights represent how strongly each criterion should influence the final decision, or in other words, how relevant each criterion is for identifying the final solution or best option. After that, every option is assessed with respect to every criterion. In the formulation used in this paper, this assessment is represented numerically as a score that indicates how well a given option satisfies a given criterion. The central calculation step of QOC then combines structure and quantification: for each option–criterion pair, the criterion weight is multiplied by the corresponding option score. The resulting weighted values are then summed across all criteria to obtain a final overall score for each option.
blocks.zh: 一旦标准被确定,质量控制程序就会为每项标准分配一个重要权重。 这些权重表明每项标准应如何有力地影响最后决定,换言之,每项标准与确定最后解决办法或最佳选择有何关系。 之后,每个选项都根据每个标准进行评估。 在本文件中使用的表述方式中,这一评估以数值表示,以表明某一选项在多大程度上满足了某一标准。 QOC的中央计算步骤然后结合结构与量化:对于每个选项–标准对,标准权重乘以相应的选项分数. 由此得出的加权值将在所有标准中加以汇总,以获得每个选项的最后总分。

blocks.en: The best option is the one with the highest total weighted score. In other words, the QOC process turns qualitative judgment into a structured ranking procedure in which the preferred answer is not chosen implicitly, but derived from explicit intermediate calculations. This is important for our work because it allows us to evaluate internal consistency: we can check whether the model identifies reasonable criteria, whether the weighting and scoring steps are performed correctly, whether the option-level products and final sums are correct, and whether the option with the highest final score is in fact selected as the recommendation.
blocks.zh: 最好的选择是总加权分最高的. 换句话说,QOC过程将定性判断转化为结构化的排名程序,其中首选答案不是隐含选择,而是从明确的中间计算中推导出来的. 这对我们的工作很重要,因为它使我们能够评价内部的一致性:我们可以检查模型是否确定了合理的标准,加权和评分步骤是否正确,选项级产品和最终金额是否正确,最终得分最高的选项是否实际上被选为建议.

blocks.en: This QOC representation serves different roles across the three model generations studied in the paper. In generation 1, the QOC process is used as the complete decision core: the model produces the QOC structure and returns only the best option as the answer. In generation 2, the same QOC structure is first produced and then passed into a second interpretation step, in which the model translates the structured decision result into a richer natural-language response for the user. In generation 3, the QOC process is further extended with statistical enrichment, so that the final interpretation can draw not only on the weighted QOC scores but also on additional comparative indicators. Across all generations, however, the core QOC procedure remains the same: identify question, options, and criteria; weight criteria; score options; compute weighted totals; and select the best-supported option.
blocks.zh: 在论文所研究的三个模范代中,这种质量代表的作用各不相同。 在生成1中,QOC过程被用作完整的决定核心:模型生成QOC结构,仅返回最佳选项作为答案. 在第2代中,相同的QOC结构首先被制作出来,然后传入第二个解释步骤,其中模型将结构化的决定结果转化为用户更丰富的自然语言响应. 在生成3中,QOC过程随着统计的丰富而进一步扩大,从而最终解释不仅可以借鉴加权QOC分数,还可以借鉴额外的比较指标. 然而,在所有几代人中,核心的QOC程序保持不变:确定问题、选项和标准;加权标准;计分选项;计算加权总和;选择最佳支持选项。

blocks.en: Within the training pipeline, this structured process is not only used at inference time, but also to generate supervision data. Synthetic decision tasks are created, processed through the QOC routine, and transformed into examples for supervised fine-tuning. As a result, the fine-tuned models are encouraged to internalize QOC as their thinking process rather than merely imitate isolated outputs. The purpose of this design is to make decision support more reliable, auditable, and interpretable than in a purely free-form reasoning setup.
blocks.zh: 在培训过程中,这种结构化的过程不仅用于推论时间,而且用于生成监督数据. 合成决定任务被创建,通过QOC常规处理,并转化为被监督微调的例子. 因此,鼓励微调模型将QOC作为思维过程内部化,而不仅仅是模仿孤立的产出. 这种设计的目的是使决策支持比纯自由形式的推理设置更可靠,更可审计,更可解释.

blocks.en: 4 Architecture
blocks.zh: 4 建筑

blocks.en: This section describes the end-to-end architecture of our QOC-based training approach. Across all three generations, the core system is built around synthetic data generation, structured QOC analysis, and supervised fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们基于QOC的培训方法的端到端架构. 在所有三代人中,核心系统都是围绕合成数据的生成,结构化的QOC分析,以及监督的微调构建的.

blocks.en: The shared pipeline is as follows. First, we generate synthetic decision tasks consisting of a question and a context that are suitable for QOC-style decomposition. Second, each task is processed by a prompt-based QOC agent that executes a fixed analysis routine: identify options and criteria, assign criterion weights, and score how strongly each option satisfies each criterion. Third, the agent derives the best option from the weighted assessment. Finally, generated artifacts are converted into training examples and used to fine-tune the target LLM. This shared architecture is the backbone of all generations; each generation differs only in what additional artifacts are produced and used during answer synthesis.
blocks.zh: 共享管道如下. 首先,我们产生合成决定任务,包括一个问题和一个适合QOC式分解的上下文. 第二,每个任务由一个即时的QOC代理处理,执行固定分析常规:确定选项和标准,分配标准权重,并给每个选项满足每个标准的程度打分. 第三,代理人从加权评估中获得最佳选择。 最后,生成的文物被转化为培训实例,并用于微调目标LLM. 这种共享的建筑是各代人的骨干;每代人只在回答合成时产生和使用哪些附加文物方面有所不同.

blocks.en: 4.1 Generation 1 Architecture: QOC-Only Decision Core
blocks.zh: 4.1 第1代架构:只决定核心

blocks.en: Generation 1 uses only the shared core pipeline, as illustrated in Figure 1 . For each synthetic task, the QOC agent produces the reasoning block and selects the best option. The output artifact for training and inference is minimal: the selected best option is returned as the final answer, without an additional interpretation stage for rich natural-language explanation.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,第一代只使用共享核心管道。 对于每一个合成任务,QOC代理生成推理块并选择最佳选项. 用于培训和推论的产出文物很少:选定的最佳选择作为最后答案返回,没有为丰富的自然语言解释增加一个解释阶段。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Generation 1 pipeline creates synthetic decision tasks, applies structured QOC analysis to identify the best option, and outputs this best option directly.
blocks.zh: 图1:第一代管道制造合成决策任务,应用结构化的QOC分析以确定最佳选项,直接输出这一最佳选项.

blocks.en: 4.2 Generation 2 Architecture: QOC + Interpretation Layer
blocks.zh: 4.2 第2代建筑:QOC+解释层

blocks.en: Generation 2 adds a dedicated interpretation component after best-option selection, as shown in Figure 2 . The QOC thinking block together with the identified best option is passed back to the LLM in a second step. This component generates a richer, user-facing response that explains the recommendation while grounding the explanation in the structured QOC result. Relative to generation 1, the architectural extension is therefore a post-QOC answer-synthesis stage.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,第2代在选择最佳选择方案后增加了一个专门的解释部分。 QOC思维障碍与确定的最佳选项一起,在第二步中转回LLM. 这个组件生成一个更丰富,用户化的响应,在结构化的QOC结果中解释建议,同时将解释作为基础. 相对于第1代,建筑延伸因此是一个QOC后解答合成阶段.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Generation 2 architecture integrates a second-stage interpretation module synthesizes a richer natural-language response grounded.
blocks.zh: 图2: 第2代架构整合了第二阶段解释模块,合成了更丰富的自然语言响应基于基础.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generation 3 Architecture: QOC + Statistical Enrichment + Interpretation
blocks.zh: 4.3 第3代架构:QOC+统计浓缩+解释

blocks.en: Generation 3 extends generation 2 with an additional statistical enrichment component between QOC analysis and final answer synthesis, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Besides the QOC block and best option, the system computes simple statistical indicators over option performance (e.g., dispersion measures such as standard deviation across criterion-level scores). These statistics are then provided to the LLM together with the QOC result and best option, enabling the final rich response to incorporate both structured decision logic and quantitative comparative evidence.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,第3代扩展了第2代,在QOC分析和最后答案综合之间增加了一个统计充实部分。 除了QOC块和最佳选项之外,系统会计算简单的统计指标而不是选项性能(例如,分散度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 然后,这些统计数据连同质量观察的结果和最佳选择一起提供给LLM,使最终的丰富反应能够纳入结构化的决定逻辑和定量比较证据。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Generation 3 pipeline extends the QOC decision core by incorporating statistical enrichment.
blocks.zh: 图3:第3代管道通过纳入统计丰富度,扩展了质量控制决定核心。

blocks.en: 5 Implementation
blocks.zh: 5 执行

blocks.en: This section describes the implementation pipeline that operationalizes the QOC-based training approach introduced in this paper. Figure 4 summarizes the end-to-end implementation workflow, from task construction and QOC processing to training data preparation and model fine-tuning. For the generation of the synthetic data, we deliberately rely on the strongest open-weights model available in the respective setup in order to maximize the quality of the generated reasoning traces and supervision signals. In the evaluation setting presented in this paper, this role is fulfilled by Qwen3.5-27B. The pipeline is organized into multiple layers, each of which contributes a distinct function in turning decision tasks into supervised examples for QOC-based model development.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍本文件中引入的基于质量控制的培训办法的实施程序。 图4总结了从任务构建和QOC处理到培训数据编制和模型微调的端到端执行工作流程. 对于合成数据的生成,我们刻意依靠各自设置中可用的最强的开放量级模型,以最大限度地提高生成的推理痕迹和监督信号的质量. 在本文所述的评价环境中,由Quen3.5-27B履行这一作用。 管道分为多层,每一层都有助于将决策任务转化为基于质量控制标准的模型开发的受监督实例。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Implementation pipeline of the QOC-based training workflow.
blocks.zh: 图4 QOC培训工作流程实施程序。

blocks.en: 5.1 Task Generation Layer
blocks.zh: 5.1 任务生成层

blocks.en: The first layer of the implementation pipeline is responsible for constructing the synthetic decision tasks used throughout the project. A corresponding Python script ensures that these example tasks are drawn from different domains rather than from a single narrow application area. Each task consists not only of a question that should be answered by means of the QOC approach, but also of a synthetic context that provides the background information required for structured decomposition under the QOC framework. This layer therefore defines the raw problem instances on which the remaining parts of the pipeline operate.
blocks.zh: 第一层实施管道负责构建整个项目所使用的合成决策任务. 一个相应的Python脚本确保这些示例任务来自不同的域,而不是来自一个单一的狭义应用区域. 每项任务不仅包括一个应当通过QOC方法回答的问题,还包括一个合成背景,为QOC框架下的结构分解提供所需的背景资料. 因此,这一层界定了输油管其余部分运作的原始问题实例。

blocks.en: 5.2 QOC Processing Layer
blocks.zh: 5.2 质量控制 处理层

blocks.en: The second layer applies the QOC thinking procedure to each generated task. At this stage, the system uses the relevant decision question, enumerates the available options, derives the criteria for evaluating these options, assigns criterion weights, and scores how well each option satisfies each criterion. The weighted criterion–option values are then aggregated so that the best-supported option can be determined from the resulting totals.
blocks.zh: 第二层将QOC思维程序应用于每个生成的任务. 在这一阶段,该系统使用相关的决定问题,列举现有备选方案,得出评估这些备选方案的标准,分配标准权重,并评分每个备选方案满足每个标准的程度。 然后对加权标准-选项值进行汇总,以便从得出的总数中确定最佳支持的选项。

blocks.en: 5.3 Artifact Construction Layer
blocks.zh: 5.3 人工构造层

blocks.en: Once the QOC analysis has been completed, the implementation pipeline converts the intermediate reasoning outputs into structured artifacts that serve as the data input for the generation of the synthetic training data in the next step. At this stage, the depth of the constructed QOC process depends on the model generation. For generation 1, the constructed representation contains the identified options, the criteria, the criterion weights, and the evaluation of how strongly each option supports the different criteria. The weighted products between option-support values and criterion weights, together with the final sums for each option, are also calculated so that the best option can be identified and reported to the user in the simplest possible form, namely as the final selected option. For generation 2, this process depth is extended by generating a more detailed answer in a second pass through the LLM. This answer is grounded in the QOC analysis and can reflect not only the best option, but also the relative standing of alternative options. In generation 3, the constructed process is extended further with additional statistical measures, for example to identify particularly important criteria or other relevant comparative properties of the option structure. This layer therefore bridges raw reasoning traces and reusable supervision signals for the subsequent generation of synthetic fine-tuning data.
blocks.zh: QOC分析完成后,执行管道将中间推理输出转化为结构化的文物,作为下一步生成合成训练数据的数据输入. 在这个阶段,构建的QOC过程的深度取决于模型生成. 就第一代而言,构建的表述包含已确定的选项,标准,标准权重,以及对每个选项支持不同标准的力度的评价. 还计算了选项支持值与标准权重之间的加权产品,以及每个选项的最终总和,以便以尽可能简单的形式,即作为最后选定的选项,确定最佳选项并向用户报告。 对于第2代,通过第二次通过LLM生成更详尽的答案来扩展这个过程深度. 这个答案基于QOC分析,不仅可以反映最佳选项,还可以反映替代选项的相对地位. 在第3代中,通过额外的统计措施,进一步扩展了构建的过程,例如,确定选择结构特别重要的标准或其他相关的比较性。 因此,这一层将原始推理痕迹和可重复使用的监管信号连接起来,用于随后生成合成微调数据。

blocks.en: 5.4 Fine-Tuning Data Preparation Layer
blocks.zh: 5.4 微调数据准备层

blocks.en: The next layer transforms the generated artifacts into concrete supervised training examples. Based on the QOC data generated in the previous step, the model is additionally asked to analyze the results of the QOC analysis and to produce a final answer derived from this structured evaluation. For generation 1, this simply means adding one sentence that recommends the option with the highest score. For generations 2 and 3, an additional run through the base LLM is performed in order to obtain richer answers and increase transparency. The resulting data is then organized so that the QOC analysis itself is injected into the thinking block of the response, while the generated answer based on this QOC analysis is injected as the final answer of the model. In this way, prompts, intermediate QOC representations, preferred options, and, where applicable, richer natural-language responses are assembled into a format suitable for fine-tuning. The purpose of this layer is to ensure that the target model is not trained only on final answers, but on outputs that reflect the intended QOC reasoning structure.
blocks.zh: 下一层将生成的文物转化为具体监督的培训实例。 根据前一步骤生成的QOC数据,该模型还被要求分析QOC分析结果,并从这一结构化评价中得出最终答案. 对于第一代第1话,这仅仅意味着增加一句话,建议以最高分的选项. 对第二代和第三代来说,为了获得更丰富的答案和提高透明度,还要通过LLM进行额外的运行。 由此产生的数据随后被组织起来,使QOC分析本身被注入到反应的思维块中,而基于这个QOC分析生成的答案则被注入作为模型的最终答案. 这样,便将提示、中间QOC表述、首选选择以及适用的更丰富的自然语言反应汇编成适合微调的格式。 这一层的目的是确保目标模型不仅在最终答案方面,而且在反映预期的QOC推理结构的输出方面得到训练.

blocks.en: 5.5 Model Fine-Tuning Layer
blocks.zh: 5.5 模型微调图层

blocks.en: After the training examples have been prepared, they are used to fine-tune the target LLMs. In the context of this paper, this layer corresponds to adapting the different Qwen3.5 base models so that they internalize not only the QOC procedure as part of their reasoning behavior, but also the generation of corresponding final answers derived from this structured analysis. Fine-tuning thus shifts the models from general-purpose base behavior toward a more structured decision-making process grounded in explicit QOC analysis and its answer-level realization.
blocks.zh: 在编制培训实例之后,这些实例被用来调整目标有限责任公司。 在本论文中,这一层对应不同的Quen3.5基模型,以便它们不仅将QOC程序作为推理行为的一部分内部化,而且从这种结构化分析中产生相应的最终答案. 因此,精细调整将模型从通用基础行为转向基于明确的质量控制分析及其答案层面实现的更有条理的决策过程。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6. 评价

blocks.en: This section evaluates the behavior of the generation 2 fine-tuned model, which uses the QOC model as its internal thinking process. Our goal is to assess not only whether the model follows the intended QOC procedure, but also whether this fine-tuning strategy leads to measurable improvements over the underlying non-fine-tuned base models.
blocks.zh: 本节评价生成2微调模型的行为,该模型使用QOC模型作为其内部思维过程. 我们的目标是不仅评估该模型是否遵循了预期的质量控制程序,而且评估这一微调战略是否导致比基本的非精细调整基模型有可衡量的改进。

blocks.en: We conduct the evaluation along two complementary dimensions. First, we analyze internal consistency, which we define as the extent to which the model correctly performs the calculations required by the QOC framework, including the weighting and scoring steps that determine the final decision. Second, we compare the performance of the fine-tuned models against their corresponding non-fine-tuned base models in order to measure the practical effect of QOC-based fine-tuning on overall model quality.
blocks.zh: 我们按照两个相辅相成的方面进行评价。 首先,我们分析内部的一致性,我们界定模型正确进行QOC框架所要求的计算的程度,包括决定最终决定的权重和评分步骤. 二,将微调模型的性能与相应的非微调基模型进行比较,以衡量基于QOC的微调对整体模型质量的实际效果.

blocks.en: As the evaluation scenario, we created a benchmark set of 100 example questions, each paired with a corresponding context, drawn from different domains in which the QOC approach is well suited for structured decision-making. We then ran these questions through both the non-fine-tuned base models and the corresponding fine-tuned models across multiple parameter scales. For this evaluation, we used the Qwen3.5 family in all available model sizes: 0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B.
blocks.zh: 作为评价设想,我们创建了一套基准,由100个实例问题组成,每个实例问题都有相应的背景,它们来自不同领域,其中质量控制方法非常适合结构化决策。 然后我们通过非精细调试的基础模型 和相应的精细调试模型 跨多个参数尺度。 为了这一评价,我们在所有可用的模型尺寸中都使用了Quen3.5家族:0.8B,2B,4B,9B和27B.

blocks.en: 6.1 Evaluation of the Internal Consistency
blocks.zh: 6.1 评价内部一致性

blocks.en: In this subsection, we evaluate the internal consistency of the fine-tuned QOC models. By internal consistency, we mean whether the models correctly perform the calculations required to make decisions according to the QOC framework. In particular, these calculations combine the importance weights assigned to the identified criteria with the scores that represent how strongly each available option satisfies each criterion. Operationally, this first corresponds to multiplying the criterion weights by the respective option-level support values. These weighted values must then be summed to obtain the final score for each option. The recommended answer is the option with the highest overall score. Accordingly, our internal-consistency check does not only examine whether the intermediate calculations and final option sums are correct, but also whether the model identifies the option with the highest sum as the preferred option.
blocks.zh: 在本小节中,我们评价微调QOC模型的内部一致性. 从内部一致性来看,我们是指模型是否正确进行根据QOC框架作出决定所需的计算. 特别是,这些计算将指定标准的重要性权重与分数结合起来,这些分数代表了每个现有选项在多大程度上满足了每个标准。 在操作上,这首先相当于将标准权重乘以相应的选项级支持值. 然后,这些加权值必须相加,才能获得每个选项的最后得分。 建议的答案是总分最高的选项。 因此,我们的内部一致性检查不仅审查中间计算和最终选择总和是否正确,而且审查模型是否将最高选择总和确定为首选选择。

blocks.en: Table 1: Internal consistency of QOC-based fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models
blocks.zh: 表1:基于QOC的微调Quen3.5模型的内部一致性

blocks.en: In Table 1 , correct examples indicate benchmark instances for which all QOC-related calculations were performed correctly. Correct and wrong options refer to the number of individual option-level score calculations classified as correct or incorrect, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,正确的例子表明所有与质量控制有关的计算都正确进行的基准实例。 正确和错误的选项分别指被归类为正确或不正确的单个选项级别分数计算的数量.

blocks.en: The results show a clear and consistent relationship between model size and internal QOC consistency. The smallest model, Qwen-3.5-0.8B-QOC, performs very poorly, solving only 2 benchmark examples fully correctly and producing incorrect option-level calculations in the overwhelming majority of cases. Performance improves substantially at 2B, where the model already produces a majority of correct option-level calculations, but still fails on many complete examples. From 4B onward, the fine-tuned models show strong internal consistency, with the 4B model reaching nearly 89% correct option-level calculations and the 9B and 27B variants achieving very high consistency. In particular, the 27B model solves 95 of 100 examples fully correctly and reaches almost 99% correctness at the option-calculation level. Overall, the table indicates that QOC-style fine-tuning becomes substantially more reliable as model capacity increases, with the larger models being able to execute the required weighted scoring and final option selection with high accuracy.
blocks.zh: 结果显示模型大小与内部QOC一致性之间有着明确一致的关系. 最小的模型Quen-3.5-08B-QOC性能极差,只完全正确解决了两个基准实例,在绝大多数情况下产生了不正确的选项级计算. 2B的性能大幅提高,该模型已经产生大多数正确的选项级计算,但仍在许多完整的例子上失败. 从4B开始,微调模型显示出强烈的内部一致性,4B模型达到了近89%的正确选项级计算,9B和27B变体实现了极高的一致性. 特别是27B型完全正确解决了100个例子中的95个,在选项计算级别上达到了近99%的正确度. 总的来说,该表显示,随着模型容量的提高,QOC式的微调已大大增强可靠性,较大的模型能够以高精度执行所需的加权评分和最终选项选择.

blocks.en: 6.2 Evaluation of the Fine-Tuned vs. the Non-Fine-Tuned Base Models
blocks.zh: 6.2 评测精品对非精品基地模式.

blocks.en: In this subsection, we compare the outputs of the fine-tuned QOC models with the outputs of the corresponding non-fine-tuned base models by using an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation setup [ 12 ] . In this setup, the answer generated by a fine-tuned model is evaluated against the answer generated by a non-fine-tuned model for the same benchmark instance, and a judge model determines which of the two responses is preferable. In our case, the judge model was Google Gemini Flash Lite 3.1. We then measure how often the fine-tuned model response is preferred over the non-fine-tuned response. This comparison is intended to capture practical answer quality rather than internal calculation correctness alone. To assess whether the observed preference counts differed significantly from equal performance, we applied an exact two-sided binomial test to each pairwise comparison in Table 2 . Under the null hypothesis, the fine-tuned and base model are equally likely to be preferred, corresponding to a preference probability of 0.5. A significant positive deviation indicates that the fine-tuned model was preferred more often than expected under equal performance, whereas a significant negative deviation indicates an advantage of the base model.
blocks.zh: 在本小节中,我们通过使用LLM-as-a-Judge评价设置,将微调QOC模型的输出与相应的非fine-turned基础模型的输出进行比较[12]. 在这个设置中,由微调模型生成的答案会根据同一基准实例的非微调模型生成的答案来评价,而法官模型则决定两个响应中哪一个更可取. 在我们的案子里 法官模型是Google双子座闪光灯3.1 然后,我们衡量微调模型反应比非微调反应更受青睐。 这种比较的用意是掌握实际答案的质量,而不仅仅是内部计算的正确性。 为了评估观察到的偏好计数是否与同等性能有很大不同,我们对表2中的每个对等比较都采用了精确的双面二进制测试。 在无效假说下,微调模型和基模型同样有可能被偏好,相当于偏好概率0.5. 显著的正偏差表明,在等效性能下,微调模型比预期更受青睐,而显著的负偏差则表明基准模型的优势.

blocks.en: Table 2: LLM-as-a-Judge preferences for fine-tuned QOC models over non-fine-tuned base models.
blocks.zh: 表2:LLM-as-a-Judge对微调QOC模型的偏好,而不是非精细调试的基础模型.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports how often, across the benchmark set, the answer produced by a fine-tuned QOC model was preferred by the judge over the answer produced by a non-fine-tuned base model. Each cell gives the number of preferences for the fine-tuned model out of 100 pairwise judgments, while the superscript markers indicate whether this observed count deviates significantly from equal performance under an exact two-sided binomial test with a significance threshold of p = 0.05 p=0.05 . Entries marked with ∗ indicate a significant advantage of the fine-tuned model, whereas entries marked with † indicate a significant advantage of the base model.
blocks.zh: 表2报告,在整个基准套中,法官往往倾向于微调QOC模型生成的答案,而不是非微调基础模型生成的答案。 每个单元格在100对偶判断中给出了微调模型的首选次数,而上标则表示这个观察到的计数是否在精确的双面二进制测试中明显偏离了等效性,其意义阈值为p=0.05p=0.05. 标有 * 的条目表示微调模型的一大优势,而标有 的条目表示基础模型的一大优势.

blocks.en: The diagonal entries compare each fine-tuned model against its base model of the same size and therefore provide the clearest estimate of the effect of QOC-based fine-tuning. All diagonal entries are marked with ∗ , showing that the fine-tuned models outperform their corresponding base models significantly across all tested parameter scales. The improvement is strongest for the smaller models: the 0.8B-QOC model is preferred in 98 of 100 cases over the 0.8B base model, the 2B-QOC model in 87 cases, and the 4B-QOC model in 82 cases. The advantage remains strong at 9B with 79 preferred outputs and is still statistically significant at 27B with 61 preferred outputs. These results indicate that QOC-based fine-tuning yields consistent and statistically robust gains when models are compared against their same-size baselines.
blocks.zh: 对角条目将每个微调模型与其大小相同的基模型进行比较,因此对QOC基微调的效果提供了最明确的估计. 所有对角条目都标注为 * ,显示微调模型在所有测试参数尺度上显著超过其相应的基准模型. 对于较小的模型来说,改进最强:在100个案例中,有98个案例偏好0.8B-QOC模型,在87个案例中偏好2B-QOC模型,在82个案例中偏好4B-QOC模型. 9B的优势仍然很大,有79项优先产出,27B的优势仍然很大,有61项优先产出。 这些结果表明,在将模型与相同规模的基线进行比较时,基于质量OC的微调产生一致和统计上强有力的收益。

blocks.en: The off-diagonal entries provide a more demanding cross-size comparison. They show how often a fine-tuned model of one size is preferred over a larger non-fine-tuned base model. Here, the significance markers help distinguish robust cross-size gains from comparisons that are compatible with equal performance. For example, the 9B-QOC model is preferred 53 times over the 27B base model, and the 4B-QOC model is preferred 49 times over the 27B base model; neither result is marked as significant, which indicates that these counts do not differ reliably from equal performance. By contrast, the 4B-QOC model is preferred 81 times over the 9B base model and the 2B-QOC model is preferred 66 times over the 4B base model, both with significant positive deviations. At the other end of the spectrum, several entries for the 0.8B-QOC and 2B-QOC models against much larger base models carry the † marker, showing significant negative deviations and thus a clear advantage of the larger base model.
blocks.zh: 非对角条目提供了更严格的跨尺寸比较. 它们显示,一个尺寸单一的微调模型往往比更大的非精度微调基模型更受青睐。 在此,意义标记有助于区分强跨大小收益和与等效性兼容的比较. 例如,9B-QOC模型比27B基模型首选了53倍,4B-QOC模型比27B基模型首选了49倍;结果都没有标记为显著,这表明这些计数与等效性能没有可靠的区别. 相比之下,4B-QOC模型比9B基模型首选81次,2B-QOC模型比4B基模型首选66次,两者都有显著的正偏差. 在光谱的另一端,针对大得多的基模型的0.8B-QOC和2B-QOC模型的多个条目都搭载了QQ标记,显示出显著的负偏差,因此是较大基模型的明显优势.

blocks.en: Overall, the table indicates that QOC-based fine-tuning consistently improves the quality of model answers relative to the corresponding non-fine-tuned base models and that these gains are especially pronounced for small and medium model sizes. At the same time, the binomial-test results refine this interpretation by showing where the observed preference counts reflect statistically meaningful deviations from equal performance and where they do not. The gradual reduction of the diagonal advantage from 98 at 0.8B to 61 at 27B suggests that fine-tuning yields the largest relative benefit where the base model is still comparatively weak. For stronger base models, the gains remain positive and statistically significant on the diagonal, but the margin narrows because the underlying model already provides more competitive answers before fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,该表表明,基于QOC的微调与相应的非精细调试基模型相比,不断提高模型答案的质量,这些收益对于中小型模型大小尤其明显. 同时,二元测试结果通过显示所观察到的偏好在哪些方面反映了统计意义与同等业绩的偏差以及哪些方面没有偏差来完善这一解释. 对角优势逐渐从98 at 0.8B降低到61 at 27B,表明微调在基础模型仍然相对薄弱的地方产生最大的相对效益. 对于更强大的基础模型,收益在对角线上仍然是积极和统计上重要的,但比值缩小,因为基础模型在微调前已经提供了更具竞争力的答案。

blocks.en: Table 3 reports Bradley–Terry scores [ 1 ] estimated from the full set of pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge comparisons. Whereas Table 2 presents the raw preference counts for individual model pairs, the Bradley–Terry analysis aggregates these pairwise outcomes into a single latent strength score for each model. Higher scores indicate that a model was preferred more often across the overall comparison graph. Thus, Table 2 provides a local view on specific pairwise matchups, while Table 3 provides a global ranking of all models within a shared preference space.
blocks.zh: 表3 报告 Bradley – Terry 得分 [1] 根据整套双智 LLM-as-a-judge 对比估计. 表2列出了单个模型对的原始偏好数,而布拉德利-特里分析则将这些双向结果汇总为每个模型的单一潜在强度分数。 较高的分数表明,在整个比较图中更倾向于采用模型。 因此,表2提供了特定对偶匹配的局部视图,表3提供了共享偏好空间内所有模型的全球排名.

blocks.en: Table 3: Bradley–Terry scores for base and fine-tuned QOC models
blocks.zh: 表 3: Bradley – Terry 基准和微调QOC模型的分数

blocks.en: The Bradley–Terry ranking is broadly consistent with the previously reported pairwise results. The strongest positions are occupied by fine-tuned QOC models, with Qwen-3.5-27B-QOC receiving the highest overall score, followed closely by Qwen-3.5-4B-QOC and Qwen-3.5-9B-QOC. This reflects the earlier observation that fine-tuned models are frequently preferred over their non-fine-tuned counterparts and often remain competitive even in more demanding cross-size comparisons. The ranking also shows that the base Qwen-3.5-27B model remains strong in absolute terms, which aligns with the pairwise table where some smaller fine-tuned models did not achieve significant wins against the strongest base models.
blocks.zh: Bradley–Terry排名与此前报道的对等结果大体一致. 最强位置由微调的QOC模型占据,Qwen-3.5-27B-QOC获得最高总分,紧随其后的是Quen-3.5-4B-QOC和Quen-3.5-9B-QOC. 这反映了早先的看法,即微调模型往往比非微调模型更受青睐,即使在要求更高的跨大小比较中也往往保持竞争力。 排名还显示,基数的Qwen-3.5-27B模型在绝对值上仍然很强,这与一些较小的微调模型没有在最强的基数模型上取得显著胜利的对等表一致.

blocks.en: At the lower end of the ranking, the base Qwen-3.5-0.8B model serves as the reference point, while Qwen-3.5-2B and Qwen-3.5-0.8B-QOC occupy comparatively weak positions in the global ordering. This complements the pairwise analysis by showing that, although the 0.8B-QOC model substantially improves over its own base model, it still remains below larger fine-tuned and base models in the overall comparison space. In this sense, the Bradley–Terry table refines the interpretation of the earlier evaluation: the pairwise table identifies where fine-tuning yields significant wins in direct head-to-head matchups, whereas the Bradley–Terry model summarizes these outcomes into a single global ordering that reveals the broader relative strength of all models considered together.
blocks.zh: 在排名的下端,基数的Quen-3.5-0.8B模型作为参考点,而Quen-3.5-2B和Quen-3.5-08B-QOC在全球订单中占据相对薄弱的位置. 这补充了双向分析,表明尽管0.8B-QOC模型大大改进了其自身的基础模型,但在总体比较空间中,它仍然低于更大的微调模型和基础模型。 从这个意义上讲,布拉德利-特里表完善了对早期评价的解释:双向表确定了微调在直接对头比对中产生显著胜利之处,而布拉德利-特里模型则将这些结果归纳为单一的全球订单,揭示了所有模型放在一起考虑的更广泛的相对优势。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: This work provides evidence that the internal thinking model of an LLM can be changed deliberately and that such a change can be beneficial. In our case, the target behavior was not a generic increase in reasoning verbosity, but the adoption of a specific structured decision process: Question–Option–Criteria (QOC). Across the implementation and evaluation results, the central finding is that this structured thinking model can be internalized through fine-tuning and can improve both the internal quality of model reasoning and the externally observed quality of model answers. This is an important result because it suggests that the internal reasoning style of an LLM is not fixed, but can be shaped toward task-specific cognitive structures that are better aligned with particular application domains.
blocks.zh: 这部作品提供了证据,证明LLM的内部思维模式可以被刻意改变,这种改变可以是有益的. 就我们而言,目标行为并不是推理动词的泛泛增加,而是采用具体的结构化决策过程: Question–object–Criteria(QOC). 在整个实施和评价结果中,中心结论是,这种结构化思维模式可以通过微调实现内在化,既可以提高模型推理的内部质量,也可以提高模型答案的外部观察质量. 这是一个重要的结果,因为它表明LLM的内部推理风格不是固定的,而是可以被塑造成更符合特定应用域的任务特定认知结构.

blocks.en: The internal-consistency evaluation makes this particularly clear. The larger fine-tuned models were able to perform the required QOC calculations with high reliability, including criterion weighting, option scoring, weighted aggregation, and final option selection. The pairwise comparison with non-fine-tuned base models further shows that these structured reasoning traces are not merely internally neat, but also translate into better outputs from the perspective of an external judge. Together, these two findings suggest that changing the thinking model of an LLM is not only possible in principle, but can produce practically meaningful benefits when the model is capable of executing the target structure faithfully.
blocks.zh: 内部一致性评价特别清楚。 较大型的微调模型能够以高可靠性进行所需的QOC计算,包括标准加权、选项评分、加权汇总和最后选项选择。 与非精细调试的基础模型的对等比较进一步表明,这些结构化推理痕迹不仅内部整齐,而且还从外部法官的角度转化为更好的产出. 这两项结论合在一起表明,改变LLM的思维模式不仅原则上是可能的,而且当模型能够忠实地执行目标结构时,可以产生实际有意义的效益.

blocks.en: At the same time, the results strongly indicate that the usefulness of increasingly deep QOC-style thinking depends on model size. The smallest models, especially the 0.8B variant, struggle substantially with the internal computational requirements of the QOC framework. Even though fine-tuning still improves their outputs relative to their own base versions, their low internal consistency suggests that these models have limited capacity for reliably executing a fully elaborated QOC process. This points to an important design implication: for small models, simpler forms of structured thinking may be more appropriate, especially thinking processes that do not require complex analytical structures. In the terminology of this paper, such models may be better suited to generation 1, where the core QOC structure is present but the additional computational and interpretive depth remains limited.
blocks.zh: 同时,结果强烈表明,日益深入的QOC式思维的有用性取决于模型大小. 最小的模型,特别是0.8B变体,与QOC框架的内部计算要求有很大的矛盾. 尽管微调相对于自己的基础版本,其产出仍然有所改善,但其内部一致性低,表明这些模型可靠地执行一个充分阐述的质量控制程序的能力有限。 这指出了一个重要的设计含义:对于小模型来说,更简单的结构化思维形式可能更合适,尤其是不需要复杂的分析结构的思维过程. 在本文的术语中,这种模型可能更适合第1代,因为核心QOC结构存在,但额外的计算和解释深度仍然有限。

blocks.en: The picture changes for larger models. From the middle range upward, and especially from 9B onward, the fine-tuned models show that they can not only benefit from a changed thinking model, but also sustain more profound forms of it. The 9B and 27B models achieve high internal consistency and strong answer quality in pairwise comparison, which suggests that these model sizes are capable of supporting the richer forms of QOC-based reasoning represented by generations 2 and 3. In other words, once the model has sufficient representational and computational capacity, the introduction of a more elaborate internal thinking model appears not to overload the model, but instead to improve its ability to make, justify, and communicate decisions.
blocks.zh: 画面为更大的模型而变化. 从中间范围向上,特别是从9B向上,微调模型表明,它们不仅能够从改变思维模式中受益,而且还能够维持更深刻的形式. 9B型和27B型在对称比较中实现了较高的内部一致性和强答质量,这表明这些模型尺寸能够支持以第二代和第三代为代表的更丰富的基于QOC的推理形式. 换句话说,一旦该模型具有足够的代表性和计算能力,采用更细致的内部思维模型似乎不会使模型超负荷,而是提高其做出,论证和沟通决定的能力.

blocks.en: A reasonable interpretation of the current results is therefore that all model sizes can benefit from a more structured internal thinking model, but not all model sizes benefit equally from the same depth of structure. Smaller models seem to benefit mainly from the existence of an explicit decision scaffold, while larger models can additionally profit from more detailed intermediate calculations, richer answer synthesis, and possibly even statistically enriched decision representations. This suggests that the choice of thinking model should not be treated as one-size-fits-all, but should instead be adapted to model capacity. The question is not only whether a structured thinking model is useful, but also how much structure a model of a given size can realistically maintain without losing reliability.
blocks.zh: 因此,对当前结果的合理解释是,所有模型大小都可以从结构更合理的内部思维模型中受益,但并非所有模型大小都同样受益于同一深度的结构. 较小的模型似乎主要得益于一个明确的决策脚手架的存在,而较大的模型则可以从更详细的中间计算,更丰富的答案综合,甚至可能从统计上丰富决策表达方式中获得额外的利润. 这表明,思维模式的选择不应被视为一刀切,而应适应模型能力。 问题不仅在于结构化的思维模式是否有用,而且在于一个特定大小的模型在不失去可靠性的情况下能够实际维持多少结构.

blocks.en: These findings also have broader implications for LLM design. Much recent work has emphasized improved reasoning through scaling and through general-purpose reasoning methods such as chain-of-thought prompting and self-improvement supervision [ 2 , 9 , 11 ] . Our results instead support a complementary perspective: part of the performance gain may come from selecting and training an appropriate internal reasoning format. In this view, the design of the thinking model becomes a first-class research question. QOC is one example, but the underlying principle is more general. Different tasks may benefit from different internal reasoning models, and the best choice may depend jointly on the task type, the desired form of explainability, and the size of the target model.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果对LLM设计也有更广泛的影响. 最近的许多工作都强调通过规模化和一般目的推理方法,例如思维链促动和自我改进监督[2、9、11]改进推理。 相反,我们的成果支持一种互补的观点:业绩收益的一部分可能来自选择和培训适当的内部推理格式。 在这种观点下,思维模型的设计成为一流的研究问题. QOC就是一个例子,但基本原则更为笼统。 不同的任务可能得益于不同的内部推理模型,最佳选择可能共同取决于任务类型,理想的解释形式,以及目标模型的大小.

blocks.en: There are, however, important limitations to this interpretation. First, the present study evaluates only one family of base models and one structured thinking model. Second, the thresholds suggested here, for example, the idea that smaller models may be better limited to generation 1 while larger models can support generations 2 and 3, should be understood as an informed interpretation of the current data rather than as a universal rule. Third, the evaluation focuses on synthetic tasks and controlled comparisons, which are well suited for methodological analysis but cannot fully capture the complexity of real-world deployment settings.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种解释有重要的局限性。 首先,本研究只评价一个家族的基础模型和一个结构化思维模型. 第二,此处提出的阈值,例如,较小的模型可能更好地局限于第1代,而较大的模型可以支持第2代和第3代的观点,应当理解为对当前数据的知情解释,而不是普遍的规则. 第三,评价的重点是合成任务和控制性比较,这些任务非常适合方法分析,但不能充分抓住现实世界部署环境的复杂性。

blocks.en: Even with these limitations, the overall pattern is clear. The paper provides empirical support for the claim that changing the internal thinking model of an LLM is both feasible and often beneficial. It also suggests that the value of deeper thinking structures increases with model capacity. This makes the deliberate design of internal reasoning processes a promising direction for future LLM development and research, especially in domains where decision quality, transparency, and controllable reasoning matter more than unconstrained generative flexibility.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性,但总体格局是明确的。 该文件为改变LLM的内部思维模式既可行又往往有益的说法提供了经验支持. 它还建议,更深层次的思维结构的价值随着模型容量的增加而增加. 这使内部推理过程的精心设计成为未来LLM发展和研究的有希望的方向,特别是在决策质量、透明度和可控制的推理比不受限制的基因灵活性更重要的领域。
